_about: Vahan maker name -> NSE ticker. Approved by the owner on 2026-10-09; a maker not listed here is kept in the data as unmapped, never assigned by guess. Change a mapping only with the owner's approval.

M&M.name: Mahindra & Mahindra
makers: MAHINDRA & MAHINDRA LTD FARM MACHINERY DIVISION
M&M.note: Subsidiaries consolidated into M&M: Last Mile Mobility (3W EV), Electric Automobile (EV SUVs). SML Mahindra is listed separately (SMLMAH) and kept apart.

TMPV.name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles
TMPV.note: Vahan carries the PV subsidiary's name back to 2024. TMPV's price series is TATAMOTORS's ISIN, which drops at the Oct 2025 demerger.

TMCV.name: Tata Motors (commercial vehicles)
TMCV.note: After the demerger 'Tata Motors Ltd' is the CV company. Listed Nov 2025, so no price before then. The FADA tab's tag 'TMLCV' is not an NSE ticker.

HEROMOTOCO.name: Hero MotoCorp
HEROMOTOCO.note: Hero Electric is a different company and is not mapped. Vida is registered under Hero MotoCorp.

BAJAJ-AUTO.name: Bajaj Auto
BAJAJ-AUTO.note: Chetak Technology is Bajaj's EV subsidiary.

EICHERMOT.name: Eicher Motors
makers: VE COMMERCIAL VEHICLES LTD (VOLVO BUSES DIVISION)
EICHERMOT.note: VECV is a JV consolidated by Eicher. 'EICHER TRACTORS' is TAFE's brand since 2005 and is NOT Eicher Motors; the FADA tab maps it to EICHERMOT, which is wrong.

ASHOKLEY.name: Ashok Leyland
ASHOKLEY.note: Switch Mobility is Ashok Leyland's EV subsidiary.

ESCORTS.name: Escorts Kubota
ESCORTS.note: Open question: 'KUBOTA AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY INDIA PVT.LTD.' is not mapped; decide whether the Kubota India merger puts it under ESCORTS.

ATULAUTO.name: Atul Auto
ATULAUTO.note: Atul Greentech is Atul Auto's EV subsidiary.

GREAVESCOT.name: Greaves Cotton
GREAVESCOT.note: Greaves Electric (formerly Ampere) is a subsidiary; Greaves Cotton has other businesses, so registrations are a partial read.
